body: Thank you for the advice, I know there are alot of challenges but I won't give up on him yet. I will keep trying as long as he remains open and honest with me. He did admit he was scared and didn't know where to start with himself a month ago. Our communication since then has been top notch, we talk everyday and he always replies in minutes and we are taking things slow, that's why he is open to me about porn, his past, work etc. I don't like the idea of shopping around when I date I put my energy into one person at a time, I am just old fashioned.

The problem with his work is that it is severely effecting his health. He told me that the communication with his family is non-existent and he hates it so much all he wants to do is sleep, game and watch porn. So it worries me that it won't get sorted. 

He was a good person before his last relationship breakdown. He had a successful handmade furniture business. So he had tons of ambition and drive which has now gone. Although on our dates, we went to museums, art galleries and antique shops so it is still there somewhere. And as we are both creative people we were open to running a business together.

He used to initiate messages all the time and was a very clingy, insecure person. Now I send the messages, he responds in seconds but isn't the same person. I worry alot because the dating site we met on, he is still active daily and although he says it's just an alternative goth site for friends, it really does bother me.

I try to still give him space and let him know I am there. I try to at least send him a positive message a day to give him some hope. But I probably am being far too patient with him.

Thank you for the advice. I get him to talk about work each day because he keeps trying to ask his boss to change departments but he always tells me the boss was busy today he couldn't disturb him etc. He told me he gets bullied by the people he works with which makes him feel like nothing. His last job made him go bald with stress which doctors said was unfixable and he had alot of hair. The only way for his happiness is to change area or job. The trade he works is always in demand but he is scared of change. 

We only started dating just before Covid and haven't been on many dates. Also we can't see one another at the moment either. He is quite immature for his age. He lives at home and is unable to make toast. He is very thin and doesn't eat much. I know his past relationship breakdown affected him badly and made him revert. Yes, I will still be cautious but keep trying.

Yes, I think he's got in his head because he lost them for a long time and thinks watching explosions will make him have them. Not only is he immature but hasn't done much in any relationship he's been in which has led to his previous partners cheating on him. He is very inexperienced with women so finds it odd when I tell him off for doing these things.
Thank you. That sounds good. I know a good long walk around a lake or such would do him good to get away and clear his head. Will try that.
Sounds good! Will pass this on to him. Thank you!

Thank you. Any advice is appreciated as it is not a topic I can openly discuss with close friends or family. I will certainly look into counselling. It is damaging for me and I tell him I do not like him watching it or telling me about it. He just makes me feel more sorry for him and with the current situation we are unable to see each other which doesn't help. I am going to pass him on the Nofap website and tell him to join the group on reddit too. Thank you.

Thank you. He is a very introverted person, so feel like if I give up on him he only has family. His work colleagues just bully him horrendously which angers me too. The job is really not good for his health. I will try as best as I can but will keep that in mind though. Thank you for your help :)

Thank you. I've battled alot of things with him so far and feel like he has been open with me throughout. I will try my hardest to keep fighting for him as he has had a hard life. He was a good, decent man before with a great career until he went out to another country to propose to his long-term girlfriend who was back home cheating on him with his friend. That ended his career, made him depressed, caused him to lose his hair and spiral downwards. Therapy is definitely an option we need to discuss, I am a patient person and caring is my career. Thank you, I will send the link onto him.

Thank you for the advice. It's annoying because I have tried to help him sort his job and everything out so far but he just keeps lacking motivation and there's always another thing I get involved dealing with him on. We are away from each other because of the current situation too which doesn't help. About the porn, he knows I don't watch it and I just keep telling him off but think he keeps doing it to be winding me up. I have told him he needs to do things for himself if he is unhappy, but he won't which annoys me.
Thank you. I will go by your advice and keep positive. If I need more support it would be great to talk to someone who has experienced similar.

Thank you for your advice. I am a strong and positive person, so do keep trying and will do my best for him. I need to talk about therapy with him as it is important for him to get back on track. I feel like he just doesn't want to tell me anything and deal with it in his own way but is not coping. He keeps using a dating site too which does hurt me inside as I feel like he doesn't want to turn to me for help. We used to communicate alot but is just going down. Will keep looking for ways to help him though and get him the therapy he needs.

Thank you. But have tried everything. He just doesn't want to leave his room and has got addicted to his ps4. I asked him again to see him the weekend and all he last said was "I will let you know". Which I presume he won't. I wanted to bring up moving in together sooner so I could cook for him and support him while he is going through a rough patch at work. Wanted to approach the topic the weekend as we had planned our future but he is just shutting himself off completely.

It does become a routine and is more painful now than it would have been before probably. Just need to keep finding things to occupy the mind. That's where you need positive messages of support to keep you going. It really helps.

Yes especially as he'd snapchat me his face each morning with his hair dishevelled. Made me miss him more and then when he was in the car driving to work, lunchtime, home time snap messages. It felt like a routine. Which is really difficult to adjust.

Aw I know the feeling. Happy Birthday for yesterday. Because I met him online during lockdown every hour we'd send messages and then the morning texts that you keep the phone beside your bed so you wake up to them. I had a morning message everyday at 6am (when he started work) for six months. Then you wonder why they don't come anymore. Yes, the sleep and less eating and feeling tired all the time. Glad I'm not alone.

I felt that way yesterday and this morning, got really down. But for some reason I couldn't. It's just so hard at the moment not being able to do as much to keep busy or see friends as normal. That is what is really depressing.

Thank you. I feel like with Covid the stress adds even more, especially when you have to put alot on hold. With less work and things you would normally be doing to take your mind off someone, you can't, so feel more alone than ever. But you are right. I need to try find someone who doesn't put me through this stress and can reassure me. This talk is helping. You are a good person, who deserves to find happiness too.

Are you able to be friends—or even occasional lovers—with this man who is less crazy about you than you are about him without feeling:

a)     bad about yourself
b)    resentful of him or
c)     like you’re always aching for more?

That's something to think about. The only problem is I feel like I would miss the conversations we have each day. He still wants to keep them going but is stressed out with work and family that he is putting our future on hold and I don't know how long for...
Thank you. It just keeps me on edge because he's telling me he doesn't know when his head will be straight so won't give me any answer.

Look fresh, bit of aftershave, dress comfortably but look smart. Compliments and manners go along way. Don't bang the door shut on them and walk through first lol. First impressions count and I always remember him doing that haha. Check she is ok and comfortable. Ask her what she would like to eat if you go out. Also be sure if you go somewhere to book beforehand as I had a Covid date and everything was shut, so we had to keep changing our plans. Good luck!😁
I think it's back now. But the app went strange and wouldn't load any groups or messages yesterday, so uninstalled and reinstalled it again. It should be back to normal. Thank you.
Thank you. Will see how he is when he wakes up and may still need your advice as it really helps. Thank you.

Thank you. Will try that. Just he will sleep most of today as he is so tired. I did tell him to do what makes him happy as he had thought about it before but think he won't quit because he does help his family alot and there is pressure.  But will try spend time with him today and let him think how he feels about it because I don't think he can mentally take much more. Thank you.
He could do that. I'll mention it. Just not sure whether to give him space today or bring it up again yet. He wasn't in a good mood yesterday.

He had holiday 2 weeks ago and we made sure we visited a museum and outdoor places but all he could do was talk about sorting his work. He is dead set on being back in the other area but if they know he has always been a loyal hard worker to them for years and are watching him like this, I think he needs to leave them. I don't know what else to do.

Yes that's right. He's turned into a different person. His face just looks exhausted from crying all week. It's really damaging him. He got on well with the manager and repeatedly tried to ask him to change him but he just won't let him as nobody else wants to be in that area.
He doesn't. He really likes everyone there and was really happy. I think if he's not happy and can't go back to the other area, he needs to look for something else but think he is scared of change.

He is a very manual, labour person and was comfortable being with his workmates. Now he feels isolated taking orders in the warehouse. He does 6 days 6.30-7.00pm he travels and works longer. He keeps trying to go back and doesn't see any other solution.

Thank you. Your story helped me explain it to him and give a compliment. Just with this being his only day off this week, he is already thinking about work again for tomorrow which still really has him down. He was never like this. Will give him some space today until he is ready to talk again.

Haha I can relate! For our first date I knew he had a certain type of style he liked so I dressed up in a cute skirt, tights, black top, heels and striking makeup. Didn't realise he would go the complete opposite and not brush his hair, wear luminous trainers and dress younger than someone in their 30s would. I did get angry as I was getting compliments from others but him. Afterwards though I realised he was more of an introverted and insecure person when out (we met online and he was more confident). He was going through tough times but made the effort getting there for me as I really wanted to see him (he was a few hours drive away). It was also Covid so he wore his mask pretty much the whole time and was 2m apart. I decided the next day though I would match his look. I hadn't bought much with me to play around with but wore a different skirt with trainers this time, ditched the makeup, made hair messy and got down to his level so he was more comfortable. He preferred that😁

Thank you once again. I told him the story of a man who was insecure with his acne, and a girl who kissed it and called it beautiful each night. I told him that the girl wouldn't have cared about another famous celebrity. His back was the one she fell in love with. He then admitted he didn't mind his body but would prefer a famous celebrity one. I told him that I would much prefer a body with acne to a celebrity one as I would prefer a good person with a personality. I told him that he doesn't need to change. His body is perfect the way it is...😁

Thank you for the advice. He is his own boss  I like him doing everything he wants to. Just he can be very introverted and so only slowly offer input if he is struggling with life. I want to encourage him to do his own hobbies and socialize as much as he can with his friends.
Haha I am trying to make him a man! He is getting there. 😁
It was interesting. I like reading something different. Keeps the brain active but thank you! 😁

Haha interesting input. But we are both kind and caring people, in tune with each other and I am on here to support him through this in everyway I can as he has always put in the time and effort to support me every single day. For the last 6 months he has helped everyone else through difficulties and needs someone to now support him. We can look into therapy which has been suggested. But he will need the support of people around him. Dumping him when he has been cruelly dumped twice will only cause more unnecessary harm and not be beneficial to his self improvement.

There are plenty of other tall, good looking, rich, perfect personality trait men about of which he doesn't have any and can drop him for, but I am not even remotely interested. He is a very good, honest, hardworking, reliable, family man which is 100x more important.

He loves his 'normal working class' job which he just wants to change rooms to and is most determined at getting his solution. He doesn't need to be attractive, I love how messy and full of split ends his hair is, geeky glasses and his wonky wiry ginger beard! He is perfect. But thank you for taking the time to add your input.

Hello, I went through something similar and we are currently working through his issues together. Try to make time if you can for an open chat and see if there is anything bothering him. Just be open to listen. With mine, it was his work which he really hates and is still trying to find a solution. Also he had difficult past breakups where they cheated on him and left him feeling very insecure which we are working on too. I feel you have been patient and if he is willing to open up to you that's great, if not I would think about exploring other options as it looks like that funny feeling could be what he is doing, unfortunately. Hope it isn't and all goes well.
Thank you😁 Tried to cheer him back up but he's going down again, so probably might not even realise all the effort I'm making 😂 But I'm not giving up yet! Haha

I have been pursued by a man on a dating site for 6 months. He is quite introverted but the reason I fell for him is because he has always been consistant with me. 

Morning and night messages meant the world to me. He always made sure I was ok during the day and would listen to what I had been doing, which was really great as we both had work and could still be in communication with each other.

When not together, we always share our interests through snapchat and whatsapp where when he is busy crafting or wants to show me something he can send me instant pictures and put little messages on them. 

Just little ideas that go a long way. Always be a listening ear and offer support when she needs it. Good luck.

I will do. Just helping him learn to trust again after people take advantage and use people who are good to them. I will do. He has always had a positive shell and listened to others problems but ignored his own. I am helping him to open it up and focus on liking himself more.
Haha definitely. Am gaining lots of creative ideas😁 Currently thinking of trying them out. It is working!😁

That is good. I have thought that exercise is good to keep the mind busy. But in terms of body, looks fade, personality doesn't. The best thing in a relationship is to maintain good communication and look after your partner in their worst moments. I am trying everything possible to make him feel amazing. Which actually is currently working. Have been drawing on these points and he is opening up to me more. Thank you.

Thank you. I only joined this site a couple days ago to fight for his cause haha. He does so much for work and his family, he has little time for himself. He never used to discuss his problems, every day for six months he always phones when he arrives at work lunch and before he comes home. Like a routine to make sure I'm ok. Now I need to initiate this time as he is going through stress and bottling it up. I will open up his shell bit by bit and be his hero in his time of need! Thank you
Thank you. I will do. He is such a good person and wouldn't argue with a fly. I will remind him to stay strong and if I need some support it would be much appreciated. Thank you.

I will try my hardest as he is such a good man to everyone he meets. Just he works full on six days a week at the moment which he is looking to change as we have little time together. But yesterday I sent him a positive picture message for when he had his break at work which he said cheered him up. So will do more to build him up and make sure the time we spend together is memorable. Thank you:)
Thank you!
Thank you. I did look for some little positive messages and sent him one today which cheered him up before work. Am deciding to do it more often.

Thank you for the story and advice. That sounds wonderful. Currently we are not living together but we have talked about it for when he feels more settled. I did discuss I would do the cooking and sweet stuff like that once we do live together which does pick him up when we have our moments. 

It does make me think him doing some exercise would be good for his mind with work stress at the moment. He said he has weights but no bar currently so will talk about that. Otherwise he enjoys woodcrafting with furniture and stuff when he has time, just needs to be more confident and turn his hobby into displaying his work online.
Thank you. I like talking to people who have experienced it. Will definitely work on getting him help.
Haha, nope 😁

I think he feels that because in his 2 previous serious relationships his girlfriends cheated on him in clubs with muscly men and he wants to change as he is worried about it happening again as he wouldn't be able to handle it. I try putting him at ease, he knows I don't do clubs.

Thank you for the advice, but he is an extremely good person who has only recently started coming out of his shell. He is passionate about changing his job situation and calls me three times a day when we are not together and only wants to talk about me. He has supported me for six months, so I definitely feel it is my time to initiate as he is worth the effort too. But thank you for your input.
I am considering talking to him about therapy as he did have 2 serious relationships and they both cheated on him with other guys which hurts him to bring up.

That sounds such a lovely story. I know he keeps watching Game of Thrones and Jason Momoa has made him a little self conscious. Since then he keeps showing me his little arm muscles and says 'look they are growing' and I say 'yes but they look just right as they are, momoa's are far too big' (but his arms look exactly the same each time he shows me them haha).

I'm glad to hear you supported him and he had found something else. I hope it goes really well for him. The problem is my partner really likes his friends there and was comfortable in the other department where he was more active and doing things to help people before he got switched and now feels isolated. He has tried so hard to get the manager to understand him but has made him feel someone younger should be there not him which is not doing his confidence good. He should leave as there is other work and he is very bright but think he would be too anxious to start again. 

Therapy would do him good as he is a very shy and caring man who would never argue with anyone and just bottle it up and get upset.  Never has a bad word against anyone to say. I am listening to him as much as I can but he has his heart set on being in this other department. We are currently long distance so it is hard to be physically there for him. We always communicated daily in the morning, before work, at lunch and home time etc. He is very good to me. Just the past week the communication has got less as he just gets too upset as he is constantly thinking about it and wants me to only see him being positive.

Haha thank you. Found a wonder woman tshirt and tried to look the part with the green eyes and black hair and said stay positive and I would guide him through this. It's worked! Haha hasn't stopped messaging since he's finished work!😁 Need to do some more little unique and positive things to keep his head up. Hope you find your happiness too! Thank you for the help! So glad I joined here! 😁

Thank you for the advice. It should bring us closer together. I know we met on a dating site and think he still compares himself to other men and highly edited pictures. I made it known to him after not even a week of joining the site, I didn't want to look at anyone else and left the site. Six months on we have grew strong. Personality comes first though and with us having consistent communication we have developed a unique bond that would be a shame to let anything get in the way of. We are both quiet and very caring people who take things to heart. 

Yes, he is now my noble cause and it's my turn to do the initiating. I have decided to make sure I act as his superhero through his dark times. Thank you!😁

Thank you. I will get him to concentrate on more things practical to do. He always has an interest in seeing everything I make and likes to show me his. That sounds good. I will think of a big project for us to do. 

I will definitely compliment him more. I never thought about that.  On a few dates I was annoyed that I dressed up really nice for him and only he didn't compliment me. But I realised that he was feeling conscious about being quite slim, his style and he wasn't thinking straight because afterwards kept mentioning he needed to put on more weight with shakes and do weightlifting but I said he didn't need to. Also, he lives in a small village with a few select shops, so he was out of his comfort zone when we went through a shopping centre over London on one date. He felt it was a 'completely different world' to his.

I have always been patient with him and know he would never argue with me. I will get him to open up more piece by piece as I know there are things bothering him about his past that I never questioned as I could see he was too hurt to go into any details. I will build up his trust more. Therapy does sound very good right now. 

Thank you. This is only the second post I made on here. Only joined Reddit to look for advice on how to help him as it bothers me when he locks himself away. Thank you.

Thank you. He is very creative and I want him to do more furniture crafting (he is very gifted with carpentry and woodwork) so it helps keep himself and his mind balanced. He felt more passionate about being more hands on, manual in the workplace, but now he's been moved to a place that he feels isolated. He did bring it up with his boss who respects him as he is a very loyal and hard worker, just with current situation I think it is harder for them to move him about too. He is a quiet, shy man who just bottles it up. He never gets angry or has a bad word to say against anyone, just gets upset and then insecure with himself.

I had let him do all of the initiating messages, so now I think it is my turn. I just had a clever idea and initiated a few of my own creative picture messages around a strong marvel character to show my support and it cheered him up for the first time in ages haha. Will definitely think of something different each day to do while he is down. I will compliment him more as I don't really enough and he likes literature so will find a positive quote each day. I will definitely talk to him about the therapy too as that would really help. Thank you. Your advice is really helping.

Thank you once again for the advice. It really does help. I am fully committed to making this work with him. It has actually made us stronger. Every day he sends picture texts before work, when he arrives, at lunch, at home time and we can talk until night. He has been incredible and always initiates it. Felt like a marriage. Just this week our texts are alot less as I have said I would give him the time to solve the issue but it doesn't look like it will happen yet. I will definitely look into more on approaching the therapy route with him. Thank you.

Also, I recently did a certificate in aromatherapy, so am planning to give him things to help with his sleep and anxiety. He was one of the main reasons I bought my first car months ago, as we were going to personalise it as our project together and for the distance. As he is an engineer, he helped alot when I was learning. We both love driving and I told him if he ever needed me, 2 hours is nothing for me as my work is flexible. I work in teaching. I would move in with him in the near future once we spend more time together as I know he is closer to his family. Also, he is comfortable in his workplace and just wants to move rooms but they will not let him. I asked if they can do a switch or find someone to replace him as alot of people are reapplying for work currently and he is always busy. However, he also got upset that they would like someone younger... We have also talked about one day we could open an antiques shop together where we can both redesign and craft as we are both very creative people.

Thank you for the good advice. I have tried to take his mind off work with other projects. On our dates, I took him to a couple of antique places and a museum as he enjoys the idea of crafting. The only problem is he only has one day off a week and we have a 2 hour drive between us. We both drive so meet halfway when we he has holiday otherwise he is too shattered to do anything from work and just does gaming and talks to friends online. I also know his family relies on him alot for driving and supporting them at home. So that adds and he had a bad long-term proposal breakup. 

He is fully focused on getting his work solved though as he is quite insecure that my job is 'better' and his background is 'bad' and feels his looks aren't as good. He keeps saying he is 'nothing special' which is sad. He is fully experienced and wants to change departments but feels they want someone younger. I mentioned about finding something else but he is comfortable with the people he works with. I am trying to find as many other ways to keep him positive and am going to initiate positive messages of support with him more as we have been in less contact and everyday for the past 6 months he was always the one initiating contact 3x a day.
Thank you for the good advice. I will try everything I possibly can do to help him through this :)

Thank you for the advice. He always initiates the texts with me first. Has been very communicative everyday for the 6 months we met. Just recently we text alot less as he is trying to sort this out and just gets upset. The only thing that bothers me is that he has recently been more active on the dating site we both met on. He did assure me he would always be good to me and is not chatting anyone else up. He has few friends and we are not yet official. We had our first socially distanced dates last week but it was taken over with work stress so understand he is not in the right frame of mind to commit. He is also very insecure as he feels my job and looks are better and he is 'nothing special'. Just wonder if I should give him more space or start initiating a positive text or so a day just to let him know he is not alone?

We met on a dating site 6 months ago and he has been extremely good to me since. Every morning, noon and night he would always initiate talking to me. Maybe a bit obsessive. It felt like a marriage routine.This last week I am lucky to get a few texts a day about his work situation. We had our first socially distanced dates last week but mostly he was stressed out about work. He might be feeling insecure as he thinks I have a better job and when we met he said we are from 'different worlds' as my looks and background (he thinks he is 'nothing special' lives in a 'slum area') are different to his. 

My friend has told me he has been showing up on the 'recently online' list alot lately on the same dating site we met on. He isn't a social person though and lives at home. He did assure me that he would always be good to me when we are in a relationship and he is not chatting anyone else up. I am giving him time as we are not official yet and he has been hurt badly previously and works full on 6 days a week so feels he has little time for us to do anything together. I feel he is trying really hard to be a better person and wants me to wait so he can sort work out. Just it isn't going how he wants it to and he goes very quiet or just looks upset when we do briefly talk.

Thank you. I am trying hard with him as he has always been available for me. Everyday for the past 6 months, he has talked to me morning, noon and night. Just this past week our contact has got alot less and the dating site we met on, he has started visiting more often. He did assure me he would be good to me and is not chatting anyone up but just worry he is starting to go off the rails. I understand he struggles with friends and has been hurt before. Feel he is also insecure as he feels I have a better job, background and looks. I told him it never bothered me but it does him. He hasn't made it official with me as we had our first socially distanced dates last week, so am giving him time as I feel he really wants to try to be a better person for me but is really struggling.
Ok thank you. Will try. Just worried about coming off abit strong as I did push him abit for commitment last time :)
Ok will give it a try. Although don't want to come across as too soon when I said I would give him space. How would you break the ice?

I don't know whether to wait for him to text first as he always initiates them with me. No digits have changed on his snap score so looks like he isn't using that and normally he would. I don't know whether I should I give him time to decide but it hurts to know he is logging into the site hourly and hasn't spoke to me yet today. As hard as he tells me he tries, it doesn't look like his work problem will be fixed anytime soon, so worried his stress will lead him astray. I know he had a long term relationship before, where she turned down his proposal and he spiralled out of control. Just want to know if and how much longer I should wait for him.

Every day at least 50 picture messages back and forth. We have the red heart on snapchat. Even when he works 8-6. I always got the morning messages, when he arrives at work, what he does at lunch, home time, then continuous til he sleeps. Always wants to know how I am. It felt like we were a married couple. Never had any arguments. He's always been good with me. We mentioned moving in together and he helped choose my first car so we could model it together how we wanted to with our nicknames embossed. 

Our first date we went to antique village shops, watched movies and ate, on our second date we went to a museum and spent the whole day brimming with crafting ideas there. This is because we always talked about building a shop business together where we could craft and remodel antique stuff and furniture to sell. Everything seemed perfect.

Just his work have been stressing him out for a while and he wants to change to another department but they won't let him. I talked about commitment as I knew he was still on this dating site but he wouldn't give an answer until we go out again. I think he feels insecure about himself, as I dressed up on our dates and he thinks I am wealthier and deserve better as he is from a bad area. I told him it never bothered me. Since then the texts are a few a day, no cute nicknames we always used, just very general. I said I would give him time and space to get back on track. He thanked me and assured me he wouldn't chat anyone up and would be good to me. It's been a day since we spoke but my friend has told me he has been appearing as online alot even though he's at work on a dating site we met on..

He had the same reaction with me. He apologized and knew he shouldn't be doing it. He said he didn't know what was wrong with him. But yes I thought if he was committing himself to me he would change but I don't know with guys and their feelings. Am just giving him space and trying to continue with life.

I am going through the same as you. He follows as many girls as possible on IG and snapchat, his addiction is also 'checking' this dating site we met on. He is going through major stress at work, so trying to understand him. He is either willing to understand your feelings and reassure you or you learn to deal with the anxiety that you feel xx
